'''Jean-Marie Souriau''' (3 June 1922, [[Paris]] &ndash; 15 March 2012, [[Aix-en-Provence]]) was a French [[mathematician]]. He was one of the pioneers of modern [[symplectic geometry]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Décès de Jean-Marie Souriau|url=http://smf.emath.fr/content/deces-de-jean-marie-souriau|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120505062547/http://smf.emath.fr/content/deces-de-jean-marie-souriau|archive-date=5 May 2012|publisher=Société Mathématique de France|language=French|accessdate=19 March 2012}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Décès Jean-Marie Souriau {{!}} Société Mathématique de France|url=https://smf.emath.fr/node/123126|access-date=2022-02-05|website=smf.emath.fr}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite journal|last1=Marle|first1=Charles-Michel|last2=de Saxcé|first2=Géry|last3=Vallée|first3=Claude|year=2012|title=Hommage à Jean-Marie Souriau|url=https://marle.perso.math.cnrs.fr/publications/HommageSouriaucorrige9.pdf|journal=Gazette des Mathématiciens|language=fr|publisher=[[Société Mathématique de France]]|volume=133}}</ref>

== Education and career ==
Souriau started studying mathematics in 1942 at [[École Normale Supérieure]] in Paris. In 1946 he was a research fellow of [[French National Centre for Scientific Research|CNRS]] and an engineer at [[ONERA]]. His PhD thesis, defended in 1952 under the supervision of [[Joseph Pérès]] and [[André Lichnerowicz]], was entitled "''Sur la stabilité des avions''" (On the stability of planes).<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Jean-Marie Souriau - The Mathematics Genealogy Project|url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=112757|access-date=2022-01-17|website=www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu}}</ref>

Between 1952 and 1958 he worked at Institut des Hautes Études in [[Tunis]], and since 1958 he was Professor of Mathematics at the [[University of Provence]] in [[Marseille]].<ref name=":1" /> In 1981 he was awarded the [[Prix Jaffé]] of the [[French Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|editor=|title=Prix Jaffé|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/archivage_site/activite/prix/laureat_jaffe.pdf|access-date=21 January 2022|website=academie-sciences.fr|publisher=[[Académie des Sciences]]|language=fr|archive-date=21 January 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220121200553/https://www.academie-sciences.fr/archivage_site/activite/prix/laureat_jaffe.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>

== Research ==
Souriau contributed to the introduction and the development of many important concepts in [[symplectic geometry]], arising from [[Classical mechanics|classical]] and [[quantum mechanics]].<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Bacry|first1=Henri|last2=Ruegg|first2=Henri|last3=Souriau|first3=Jean-Marie|date=1966-10-01|title=Dynamical groups and spherical potentials in Classical Mechanics|url=https://doi.org/10.1007/BF01645086|journal=Communications in Mathematical Physics|language=en|volume=3|issue=5|pages=323–333|doi=10.1007/BF01645086|bibcode=1966CMaPh...3..323B |s2cid=56363683 |issn=1432-0916|url-access=subscription}}</ref>

In particular, he introduced the notion of [[moment map]],<ref name=":2">{{Cite book|last=Souriau|first=J.-M.|title=Structure des systèmes dynamiques: maîtrises de mathématiques|date=1970|publisher=Dunod|isbn=2-04-010752-5|location=Paris|language=fr|oclc=1041884}}</ref><ref name=":3">{{Cite book|last=Souriau|first=Jean-Marie|title=Structure des systèmes dynamiques : Maîtrises de mathématiques|date=2008|publisher=J. Gabay|isbn=978-2-87647-321-8|edition=|location=Paris|language=fr|oclc=494510763}}</ref> gave a classification of the [[homogeneous space|homogeneous]] [[symplectic manifold]]s (now known as the [[Alexandre Kirillov|Kirillov]]–[[Bertram Kostant|Kostant]]–Souriau theorem), and investigated the [[coadjoint action]] of a [[Lie group]], which led to the first geometric interpretation of [[Spin (physics)|spin]] at a classical level.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Souriau|first=Jean-Marie|date=1974|title=Modèle de particule à spin dans le champ électromagnétique et gravitationnel|url=http://www.numdam.org/item/?id=AIHPA_1974__20_4_315_0|journal=Annales de l'Institut Henri Poincaré A|language=fr|volume=20|issue=4|pages=315–364|via={{Interlanguage link|Numérisation de documents anciens mathématiques|lt=NUMDAM|fr}}}}</ref> He also suggested a program of [[geometric quantization]]<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Souriau|first=J.-M.|date=1966|title=Quantification géométrique|url=https://projecteuclid.org/journals/communications-in-mathematical-physics/volume-1/issue-5/Quantification-g%c3%a9om%c3%a9trique/cmp/1103758996.full|journal=Communications in Mathematical Physics|volume=1|issue=5|pages=374–398|issn=0010-3616|via=[[Project Euclid]]}}</ref> and developed a more general approach to [[differentiable manifold]]s by means of [[Diffeology|diffeologies]].<ref>{{Citation|last=Souriau|first=J. M.|chapter=Groupes differentiels|date=1980|chapter-url=http://link.springer.com/10.1007/BFb0089728|title=Differential Geometrical Methods in Mathematical Physics|series=Lecture Notes in Mathematics |volume=836|pages=91–128|editor-last=García|editor-first=P. L.|place=Berlin, Heidelberg|publisher=Springer Berlin Heidelberg|doi=10.1007/bfb0089728|isbn=978-3-540-10275-5|access-date=2022-01-17|editor2-last=Pérez-Rendón|editor2-first=A.|editor3-last=Souriau|editor3-first=J. M.|chapter-url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref>{{Citation|last=Souriau|first=Jean-Marie|chapter=Groupes différentiels et physique mathématique|date=1984|chapter-url=http://link.springer.com/10.1007/BFb0016198|title=Group Theoretical Methods in Physics|series=Lecture Notes in Physics |volume=201|pages=511–513|editor-last=Denardo|editor-first=G.|place=Berlin/Heidelberg|publisher=Springer-Verlag|language=en|doi=10.1007/bfb0016198|isbn=978-3-540-13335-3|access-date=2022-01-17|editor2-last=Ghirardi|editor2-first=G.|editor3-last=Weber|editor3-first=T.|chapter-url-access=subscription}}</ref>

Souriau published more than 50 papers in peer-review scientific journals,<ref>{{Cite web|title=zbMATH Open - the first resource for mathematics|url=https://zbmath.org/authors/?q=ai:souriau.jean-marie|access-date=2022-01-17|website=zbmath.org}}</ref> as well as three monographs, on [[linear algebra]],<ref>{{Cite book|last=Souriau|first=J.-M.|title=Calcul linéaire : contient la solution détaillée des exercices|publisher=Ed. J. Gabay|year=1964|isbn=2-87647-097-7|location=Sceaux|language=fr|oclc=27757494}}</ref> on [[theory of relativity|relativity]]<ref>{{Cite book|last=Souriau|first=Jean-Marie|title=Géométrie et relativité|publisher=J. Gabay|year=1964|isbn=978-2-87647-318-8|edition=|location=Paris|language=fr|oclc=494510220}}</ref> and on [[geometric mechanics]].<ref name=":2" /><ref name=":3" /><ref>{{Cite book|last=Souriau|first=Jean-Marie|url=https://link.springer.com/book/9780817636951|title=Structure of Dynamical Systems|publisher=[[Springer Verlag]]|year=1997|language=en}}</ref> He supervised 10 PhD students.<ref name=":0"/>
